newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar ends ends off high, offshore selling.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar ends ends off high, offshore selling.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar ended off its peak on Thursday after running into some late selling out of Singapore.
The currency closed at US$0.6990/97 from its 0.6994/01 start, having traded a narrow range throughout the session.
The Trade-Weighted Index ended at 66.70 from 66.75.
One dealer said doubts were starting to emerge as to how much upside was left for the Kiwi, especially if the latest run of samurai bond issues starts to dry up and domestic yields continue to fall.
